summary: Initial end-to-end testing of LensFlow AI Real Estate Media Platform. Backend: 12/14 pytest tests pass (auth flows, presenters, concierge, projects CRUD, dashboard stats, GPT-5.2 script gen all working). Two failures: ElevenLabs TTS returns 404 voice_not_found for the configured Mia voice_id and a datetime tz mismatch in brute-force lockout causes 500 instead of 429. Frontend: Landing, Presenters, Pricing, Concierge, Login (admin/seeded), Dashboard, Projects, Studio (form loads with all controls), and Sidebar Logout all work end-to-end with proper data-testid coverage.

critical.issue: ElevenLabs returns 404 voice_not_found for voice_id 'EXAVITQu4vr4xnSDxMaC' (Mia). The hard-coded voice IDs in PRESENTERS (server.py lines 249, 259, 269, 279) are public ElevenLabs preset IDs that are NOT available on this account. As a result, TTS preview/voice synthesis is broken for ALL four presenters. Server log: "A voice with voice_id 'EXAVITQu4vr4xnSDxMaC' was not found."

Brute-force lockout throws 500 'TypeError: can\'t compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes' instead of 429. Root cause: in check_brute_force (server.py line 143) the locked_until value loaded from MongoDB is naive (BSON strips tz) while datetime.now(timezone.utc) is aware. Fix: replace tzinfo when reading, e.g. `lu = rec['locked_until']; if lu.tzinfo is None: lu = lu.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)` before comparing. Same pattern should be applied to reset_password expiry check (line 388).

integration_issues.flow: Hear-voice / TTS preview button on Presenters & Studio
integration_issues.issue: Will surface a 500 error to users because the backend ElevenLabs voice_ids are invalid for the account. UI itself loads fine.

action_items: Replace ElevenLabs voice_ids in PRESENTERS with voice IDs available on the provided ElevenLabs account. Either (a) fetch the account's voice library via GET https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/voices and pick 4 available voices, or (b) use 'eleven_turbo_v2_5' default model voices that the account has subscribed to. Verify by hitting /api/tts/preview with each new voice_id.

Fix datetime tz comparison in check_brute_force (server.py line 143) and reset_password expiry check (line 388): coerce naive datetimes from Mongo to UTC-aware before comparing — e.g. `lu = rec['locked_until']; if lu.tzinfo is None: lu = lu.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc); if lu > datetime.now(timezone.utc): ...`
Optionally re-test /api/tts/preview and brute-force lockout after fixes.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py PRESENTERS voice_ids are public ElevenLabs preset voice IDs (EXAVITQu4vr4xnSDxMaC etc.) that are NOT guaranteed to exist on a given API key. Use account-owned voices or use the /voices endpoint dynamically.

check_brute_force compares naive Mongo datetimes against aware datetime.now(timezone.utc) — same anti-pattern exists in reset_password. Pydantic models stored via insert_one preserve tz when written but reads come back naive in motor.
CORS_ORIGINS is set to explicit origins (good), but allow_origins fallback splits on '*' which would NOT actually enable wildcard with credentials. OK for now since CORS_ORIGINS is explicitly set.
/api/auth/forgot-password logs the reset link to stdout — fine for dev but should be wired to an email service before production.
Brute force keying on `{ip}:{email}` is reasonable; just fix the tz bug so it actually triggers 429 instead of 500.
All endpoints correctly exclude `_id` via projection or serializer — good.

The TTS test will keep failing until voice_ids in /app/backend/server.py PRESENTERS are replaced with voices available on the ELEVENLABS_API_KEY account. All other 12 tests should keep passing including LIVE GPT-5.2 script generation via emergentintegrations.

rca_of_the_issues.tts_404: ElevenLabs public preset voice IDs (EXAVITQu4vr4xnSDxMaC = Sarah, TxGEqnHWrfWFTfGW9XjX = Josh, 9BWtsMINqrJLrRacOk9x = Aria, JBFqnCBsd6RMkjVDRZzb = George) are not in the API key's voice library. Reproduction: POST /api/tts/preview with any of the four PRESENTERS voice_ids → 500 with detail 'voice_not_found'. Mitigation: call GET https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/voices on the provided key, pick 4 owned/shared voices, update PRESENTERS.
rca_of_the_issues.brute_force_500: After 5 failed logins, locked_until is written via Motor with tz-aware UTC datetime, but on subsequent read Mongo returns it as naive. The next login attempt evaluates `rec['locked_until'] > datetime.now(timezone.utc)` which raises TypeError → 500. Mitigation: normalize naive → aware on read.
